_comment: GitHub OAuth is the only way in and the UI hides everything until you sign in, so the
anonymous group is declared and granted NOTHING. That is the honest statement of this
application, and it is worth writing rather than omitting: a declared-and-empty role reads
as a decision, an absent one reads as an oversight.
Webhook ingestion needs no grant. The recipients inject IAsyncDocumentSession and query
Raven directly; nothing under libs/webhooks touches IPermissionService, and /api/github/* is
gated by MVC [Authorize] plus an org-access service rather than by rights.
ProjectColumn and EventColumnMapping are the Query-without-Read showcase, and here it is
forced by the model rather than chosen: both are embedded value objects reached through a
Custom.* query, with no collection registered, so a detail load could never resolve.
